extracted.name: Air fryer roasted veg
extracted.description: Air-fry vegetables instead of baking in the oven, then serve as a side with your favourite mains
ingredient_lines: 2 red onions cut into 8 wedges each
instruction_lines: Tip everything into the air fryer basket and shake to coat in the oil. Roast the veg at 200C for 20 mins, then shake again. Cook for another 10-20 mins until the veg is cooked through.
